title: Financial Scenario Model
prompt:
Compare financial outcomes under multiple assumptions.

Skills: Scenario Manager, Data Tables and Goal Seek.

Use the supplied synthetic CSV at assets/data/practical-19-financial-scenario-model.csv. A small copy/pastable sample is included below in case the CSV is not directly downloadable from the lesson page. Complete the work in a separate .xlsx copy, preserve a raw-data sheet, and check the result against the acceptance criteria. Then answer the short grading check; it does not validate the workbook itself.

Sample CSV (synthetic):
Scenario,Units,Price,CostPerUnit
Base,1000,20,12
Growth,1250,21,12.5
Pressure,900,19,13
objective: Compare financial outcomes under multiple assumptions.

options: Goal Seek changes one input to reach a formula target; Scenario Manager compares multiple input sets.
Goal Seek compares named multi-variable scenarios.
Scenario Manager solves only one formula target.
What-if analysis removes the need to document assumptions.

expected_output: Expected: scenarios use clearly documented input assumptions and results are compared using the same outcome measures.

public_tests.name: Sample-data acceptance
checklist: Input records are preserved and data types are checked.
Totals/results reconcile with a small independent calculation.
An edge case, duplicate or threshold boundary is tested where relevant.

public_tests.name: Server-side answer check
public_tests.note: A text/choice check does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook artifact.

acceptance_criteria: Expected: scenarios use clearly documented input assumptions and results are compared using the same outcome measures.
Use a labeled result area and document formulas, assumptions or transformation steps.
Compare actual results with a manual/independently calculated expected result and test one edge case.
Keep source data intact and request human review of the completed workbook; do not treat the text grader as artifact validation.
hints: Import data without losing dates, decimals or leading zeros.
Separate raw inputs, calculations and presentation outputs.
Test empty inputs, duplicated keys, boundary values or missing matches as appropriate to the scenario.

grading_config.correct_answer: Goal Seek changes one input to reach a formula target; Scenario Manager compares multiple input sets.

grading_method: Server-side choice check of the submitted answer/expression only; does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook. This workbook-practice task needs a human-reviewed artifact and test evidence for full acceptance. Match what-if analysis technique to the question: solve one target or compare named multi-variable assumptions.
retry_policy: Retries are permitted. A failed string/choice submission does not complete the exercise. Course files do not define XP; platform-wide server logic applies.
